blocks.text: Ever had your phone battery drop to 10% just when you still have a full day ahead? Between work messages, navigation, social media, video calls, and a little entertainment after hours, keeping a smartphone charged can sometimes feel like a task in itself. For young professionals who want to spend less time looking for an outlet and more time getting things done, the vivo V80 Lite 5G offers an interesting solution. Its biggest selling point is a massive 10,000mAh BlueVolt Battery, designed to keep users connected through long workdays and whatever comes after. And vivo has put that endurance to the […]...
